batchRequest.request: Fill one vacant packing shift with Sam and add a second sorting shift for Saturday afternoon.

patchOf:
root = Stack([title, kpis, rosterHeader, rosterTable, vacantHeader, vacantAlert, signupHeader, signupForm])
title = TextContent("Food Bank Volunteer Roster", "large-heavy")
kpis = SnippetCardBlock([k1, k2, k3])
k1 = SnippetCardItem("total", k1l, k1r)
k1l = IconText(k1i, "neutral", "m", "Total Slots", "This Saturday", false, "horizontal")
k1i = Icon("calendar-days", "calendar")
k1r = BoldText("number", "24")
k2 = SnippetCardItem("filled", k2l, k2r)
k2l = IconText(k2i, "success", "m", "Filled", "Confirmed", false, "horizontal")
k2i = Icon("circle-check", "status")
k2r = BoldText("number", "18")
k3 = SnippetCardItem("vacant", k3l, k3r)
k3l = IconText(k3i, "warning", "m", "Vacant", "Need volunteers", false, "horizontal")
k3i = Icon("user-plus", "people")
k3r = BoldText("number", "6")
rosterHeader = InlineHeader("Saturday Shift Roster", "Station assignments and status")
rosterTable = Table([Col("Volunteer", names), Col("Station", stations), Col("Shift", shifts), Col("Status", statuses)])
names = ["Maria Lopez", "James Chen", "Aisha Patel", "Tom Becker", "Priya Singh", "Luis Ortega", "Open", "Open", "Open", "Open", "Open", "Open"]
stations = ["Check-in", "Check-in", "Sorting", "Sorting", "Packing", "Packing", "Sorting", "Packing", "Distribution", "Distribution", "Loading Dock", "Cold Storage"]
shifts = ["8am-12pm", "12pm-4pm", "8am-12pm", "12pm-4pm", "8am-12pm", "12pm-4pm", "8am-12pm", "12pm-4pm", "8am-12pm", "12pm-4pm", "8am-12pm", "12pm-4pm"]
statuses = [Tag("Confirmed", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Confirmed", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Confirmed", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Confirmed", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Confirmed", null, "sm", "success"), Tag("Pending", null, "sm", "warning"), Tag("Vacant", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("Vacant", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("Vacant", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("Vacant", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("Vacant", null, "sm", "danger"), Tag("Vacant", null, "sm", "danger")]
vacantHeader = InlineHeader("Vacant Slots", "Where we need help most")
vacantAlert = Callout("warning", "6 slots still open", "Distribution, Loading Dock and Cold Storage are the highest priority. Sign up below to help!")
signupHeader = InlineHeader("Sign Up to Volunteer", "Pick a station and shift")
signupForm = Form("signup", signupBtns, [fName, fEmail, fStation, fShift, fNotes])
fName = FormControl("Full Name", Input("name", "Your name", "text", { required: true, minLength: 2 }))
fEmail = FormControl("Email", Input("email", "you@example.com", "email", { required: true, email: true }))
fStation = FormControl("Station", Select("station", stationOpts, "Select a station...", { required: true }))
stationOpts = [SelectItem("sorting", "Sorting"), SelectItem("packing", "Packing"), SelectItem("distribution", "Distribution"), SelectItem("dock", "Loading Dock"), SelectItem("cold", "Cold Storage")]
fShift = FormControl("Shift", RadioGroup("shift", shiftOpts, "am", { required: true }))
shiftOpts = [RadioItem("Morning", "8am-12pm", "am"), RadioItem("Afternoon", "12pm-4pm", "pm")]
fNotes = FormControl("Notes", TextArea("notes", "Dietary, mobility or other notes...", 3), "Optional")
signupBtns = Buttons([Button("Sign Up", @ToAssistant("Submit volunteer signup"), "primary"), Button("Cancel", @ToAssistant("Cancel signup"), "secondary")])
request: Fill one vacant packing shift with Sam and add a second sorting shift for Saturday afternoon.
